items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) good to go for Week 10
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Wright is going to be good to go for Sunday's game. He was able to practice in full all week, so his quad issue is nothing serious at this point. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) doubtful to play Sunday
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) is doubtful to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Franklin has been out for multiple weeks due to a shin issue, and it looks like he's going to be sidelined for yet another game on Sunday, as he's currently considered doubtful to play. The team has their bye week coming up in Week 11, however, so it seems likely that he will be good to go after that.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Brooks (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Brooks has been out for multiple weeks while recovering from an ankle issue, but his return to the lineup may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Vikings. If he's active, he may actually see a solid amount of opportunities with Josh Jacobs (finger) set to be sidelined for this game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Parsons isn't quite ready to make his return to the lineup and will be sidelined for another game on Sunday. He will likely be ready to go after the team's bye in Week 11, so their defensive front will have to continue to make due without him in the meantime.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Skyy Moore (ankle) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Moore has been sidelined by an ankle injury for close to a month, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. His availability won't have a big impact for fantasy purposes either way, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Whyle (concussion) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Josh Whyle (concussion) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Whyle is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and will be unavailable to play on Sunday as a result. His absence isn't expected to have a big impact from a fantasy perspective, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Bullard may be ruled out for Sunday's game, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to two injuries he's nursing. His absence would make life easier for Kirk Cousins and Co. on the other side of the ball.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Sean Rhyan (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: The Packers are set to be without their starting center in Week 10. Rhyan has been ruled out with an ankle issue, and it's unclear if it will cause him to miss more time beyond this game or not. Green Bay's offensive front will be weaker than usual while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (back) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: Van Ness was able to make his return to practice on Friday but is still considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. His status will likely depend on how his back feels closer to game time on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) officially ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) has officially been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: As expected, Jacobs has officially been ruled out after undergoing a procedure to address a finger injury he suffered last week. There's a real chance that he will miss more time beyond this game, so fantasy managers should expect more work for Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier McKinney (foot) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Xavier McKinney (foot) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.impact: McKinney is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to a groin issue. He is one of Green Bay's best defensive players, so their secondary will be considerably worse if he's sidelined this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Wingard (groin) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Wingard (groin) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Wingard may not be available to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with a groin issue of some kind that left him sidelined for Thursday and Friday's practices. Arizona's secondary will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Max Melton (knee/hand) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Max Melton (knee/hand) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: The Cardinals are unsure if Melton will be available to play this weekend, as he's currently dealing with a couple of different injuries. The team will make an official decision regarding his availability closer to game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hunter Long (knee) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Hunter Long (knee) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Long's knee injury leaves him with a questionable tag heading into the weekend. His potential absence on Sunday wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Higbee (illness) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Higbee (illness) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Higbee has recovered from the illness that was bothering him earlier in the week and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He hasn't been productive lately but will have a chance to step up and see more work on an injury-riddled Rams' offense in Week 10.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Myles Garrett (knee) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: The star edge rusher is going to be questionable to play on Sunday, as he's still managing a lingering knee issue right now. He is reportedly expected to play, however, which would be a significant benefit to Los Angeles' defense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (ribs) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Parkinson was limited at practice earlier in the week due to an injury to his ribs, but he was able to log a full practice session on Friday and is now off of the injury report heading into the weekend. He should be a full go against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Davis Allen (oblique) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Davis Allen (oblique) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Allen is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's recovering from an oblique injury right now and is officially questionable to play as a result. His potential absence would possibly lead to more work for Tyler Higbee this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Blankenship has missed multiple games while recovering from a couple of different injuries, but he has received full clearance to make his return to the lineup in Week 10 and will play against the Browns. Houston's secondary should see a nice boost with him back in the lineup moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Wyatt Teller (back/illness) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Wyatt Teller (back/illness) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Teller is uncertain to play against his former team on Sunday. He's dealing with multiple different issues right now, and it's unclear if he's trending towards sitting out or not. His absence would be keenly felt this week with Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) already ruled out for the Texans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The Texans are going to be without their starting left guard on Sunday, as they have ruled out Rutledge due to a neck/shoulder issue of some kind. Wyatt Teller (back/illness) and Trent Brown (wrist) are both questionable to play as well, so their offensive line might be significantly weaker than usual against the Browns this week.

items.title: Kyle Van Noy (calf) listed questionable Sunday

items.impact: Van Noy will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.impact: Al-Shaair is going to be sidelined on Sunday due to a pair of issues that he's dealing with. The Texans have already ruled out multiple key defenders for this game, so their defense is going to be much weaker than usual in this matchup against Cleveland.

items.title: Carson Wentz (ankle) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Carson Wentz is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Wentz will backup Kirk Cousins on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Anderson was added to the injury report on Thursday due to an ankle issue and is officially considered questionable to play heading into the weekend because of it. The Texans have already ruled out Danielle Hunter (hamstring), so if Anderson is sidelined as well, their defensive front will be much less formidable than usual against the Browns this week.

items.impact: Murray remains week-to-week. He will be the backup when he is healthy.
